caption: The drawing features a single, reflective vase positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The vase has a narrow neck that flares out slightly at the rim, a wider body that tapers towards the base, and rests on a round, stepped foot. The vase is rendered in shades of greenish-brown with hints of yellow and white highlights, suggesting a glass or ceramic material with a glossy surface. There are subtle reflections and glints on the vase, indicating a light source from the left. The artist’s signature, “EILEEN KNOX,” appears in small red capital letters just below and to the right of the vase. There are no other objects or decorative elements present in the composition.
title: Vase
